Writing ESP overlays and recoil control for use on live multiplayer servers is building cheat software — it harms real players who are competing fairly. That's not something I'll do regardless of how the workspace is framed.

Happy to help with legitimate game development, rendering code, graphics programming, or anything else along those lines.
